segments.text: Lesson 20
segments.translation: 第20课

segments.text: Pioneer pilots
segments.translation: 飞行先驱

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: What was the name of the first plane to fly across the English Channel?
segments.translation: 第一架飞越英吉利海峡的飞机的名字叫什么？

segments.text: In 1908 Lord Northcliffe offered a prize of ￡1, 000 to the first man who would fly across the English Channel.
segments.translation: 1908年，诺思克利夫勋爵提出，谁要是第一个飞越英吉利海峡，就送给谁1,000英镑奖金。

segments.text: Over a year passed before the first attempt was made.
segments.translation: 一年多过去了，才有人出来尝试。

segments.text: On July 19th, 1909, in the early morning, Hubert Latham took off from the French coast in his plane the 'Antoinette IV.'
segments.translation: 1909年7月19日凌晨，休伯特·莱瑟姆驾驶他的“安托瓦内特4号”飞机从法国海岸起飞。

segments.text: He had travelled only seven miles across the Channel when his engine failed and he was forced to land on the sea.
segments.translation: 他只在海峡上空飞行了7英里，引擎就出了故障，他被迫降落在海面上。

segments.text: The 'Antoinette' floated on the water until Latham was picked up by a ship.
segments.translation: “安托瓦内特”号在水面上漂浮着，直到莱瑟姆被一艘船救起。

segments.text: Two days later, Louis Bleriot arrived near Calais with a plane called 'No.XI'.
segments.translation: 两天后，路易·布莱里奥驾驶一架名为“11号”的飞机来到加来附近。

segments.text: Bleriot had been making planes since 1905 and this was his latest model.
segments.translation: 布莱里奥从1905年起就开始研制飞机，“11号”是他最新设计的型号。

segments.text: A week before, he had completed a successful overland flight during which he covered twenty-six miles.
segments.translation: 一周前，他刚完成一次成功的陆上飞行，飞行距离为26英里。

segments.text: Latham, however, did not give up easily.
segments.translation: 可是莱瑟姆并不轻易罢休。

segments.text: He, too, arrived near Calais on the same day with a new 'Antoinette'.
segments.translation: 同一天，他也带着一架新的“安托瓦内特”飞机来到加来附近。

segments.text: It looked as if there would be an exciting race across the Channel.
segments.translation: 看来会有一场飞越海峡的激动人心的比赛。

segments.text: Both planes were going to take off on July 25th, but Latham failed to get up early enough.
segments.translation: 两架飞机都准备在7月25日起飞，但莱瑟姆起晚了。

segments.text: After making a short test flight at 4.15 a.m., Bleriot set off half an hour later.
segments.translation: 凌晨4点15分，布莱里奥作了一次短距离试飞，半小时后便正式起飞了。

segments.text: His great flight lasted thirty-seven minutes.
segments.translation: 这次伟大的飞行持续了37分钟。

segments.text: When he landed near Dover, the first person to greet him was a local policeman.
segments.translation: 当他在多佛附近降落时，第一个迎接他的是当地的一名警察。

segments.text: Latham made another attempt a week later and got within half a mile of Dover, but he was unlucky again.
segments.translation: 一周后，莱瑟姆又作了一次尝试，已经飞到了距多佛不到半英里的地方，但他再次运气不佳。

segments.text: His engine failed and he landed on the sea for the second time.
segments.translation: 他的引擎再次故障，使他第二次降落在海面上。
